# REWIND Store — Full Documentation

## Overview

REWIND is a vintage and retro sportswear store based in Belgium. Sells authenticated,
steam-cleaned pre-owned clothing from brands like Lacoste, CP Company, BAPE, Fear of God,
Denim Tears, Stone Island, and more. Ships worldwide in 10-25 days.

## Tech Stack

- **Frontend:** React 18, Vite, vanilla JS SPA
- **Backend:** Express.js (Node 22)
- **Database:** Supabase (PostgreSQL)
- **Payments:** Stripe (card, Bancontact, iDEAL, Klarna, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay)
- **Email:** Resend (order confirmations, shipping updates)
- **Hosting:** Railway (https://rewind-stores.com)
- **Analytics:** Plausible (https://plausible.io/rewind-stores.com)
- **AI:** Gemini 2.5 Flash (product descriptions, chat responses)

## Key URLs

- Homepage: https://rewind-stores.com
- Sitemap: https://rewind-stores.com/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://rewind-stores.com/robots.txt
- GitHub: https://github.com/Jason533993292/rewind-store
- Admin panel: https://rewind-stores.com/#admin
- Health check: https://rewind-stores.com/api/health

## Product Categories

Brasils | Jerseys | Polos | Jumpers | Zip-up Jumpers | Tracksuits | Pants | Sets | Shoes | Jackets

## Database Schema (custom_products table)

- id (bigint, PK)
- product_id (text, slug)
- name (text) — product title
- brand (text)
- cat (text) — category
- price (numeric) — current price in EUR
- was (numeric, nullable) — original price for sale display
- stock (integer)
- sizes (text) — comma-separated, e.g. "S,M,L,XL"
- imgs (text) — JSON array of image URLs
- material (text)
- note (text) — description
- hue (integer) — color swatch HSL hue 0-360
- created_at (timestamptz)
- og_img (text)

## API Endpoints

### Public
- GET /api/health — Health check
- GET /api/custom_products — All products
- GET /api/wishlist?email=xxx — Get wishlist
- POST /api/wishlist — Save wishlist
- POST /api/create-checkout-session — Stripe checkout
- POST /api/send-order — Place order (needs x-internal-token header)
- POST /api/send-campaign — Send campaign email (needs admin auth)
- POST /api/run-tests — Run automated tests (needs admin auth)
- POST /api/chat/send — Send chat message
- GET /api/chat/messages?session_id=xxx — Get chat messages
- GET /api/chat/session-status?session_id=xxx — Check session status
- POST /api/analytics/track — Pageview tracking
- POST /api/webhook/events — Webhook receiver
- GET /api/referral — Referral program stats

### Admin (require admin session cookie)
- GET /api/admin/chat/sessions — List chat sessions
- GET /api/admin/chat/messages?session_id=xxx — View messages
- POST /api/admin/chat/close — Close session
- POST /api/admin/chat/session — Delete session
- GET /api/admin/analytics?period=7d — Analytics dashboard
- POST /api/admin/products/add — Add product
- POST /api/admin/products/update — Update product
- POST /api/admin/products/delete — Delete product
- GET /api/admin/order-lookup?q=xxx — Search orders
- POST /api/admin/orders/cancel — Cancel order
- POST /api/admin/orders/ship — Mark shipped

## Auth

- Admin: session-token-based via HMAC-signed cookies
- Internal: x-internal-token header (constant, matches ADMIN_SECRET_TOKEN env var)
- Chat: session_id stored in localStorage, verified server-side
- Stripe: publishable key in frontend, secret key server-side

## Deployment

- Railway auto-deploys from GitHub main branch
- Build: `npm run build` (Vite), Start: `node server.js`
- CSP header set server-side with hashed inline scripts

## Rate Limiting

- General: 300 req/min per IP
- Strict (writes): 10 req/min per IP
- Chat auto-mute: 20 messages then muted
